ትረክቢ: ረከበ — you will find (2fs imperfect, G)

ወአሜሃ: አሜሃ — and then, at that time (ወ- + adverb)

መሪጎ: መሪጎ — having ground, crushed (gerund in form; the root and the sense are uncertain) (?)

ጠቢቃተ: ጠቢቅ — strong, severe (adjective, plural accusative ጠቢቃተ)

መገብት: መጋቢ — stewards (plural; the plural form is not as I expect) (?)

__broaden__.ወመሳትየ: መስተይ — and drinks, drinking vessels (ወ- + plural መሳትይ of መስተይ 'drink, potion', accusative; from ሰትየ 'drink') (?) · drinks / drinking-vessels as the text uses it (ወመሳትየ መፂፃነ 'and drinks ...', ch. 29): plural of መስተይ, here the drinks themselves as well as the cups
__broaden__.ወታስተዐጽብ: አስተዐጸበ — and she wonders, is amazed (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, ʾastä-stem; cf. ዕጹብ 'wonderful, astonishing'; the same verb as ch. 22 ያስተዐጽብ 'he marvelled, was astonished') · also 'she is astonished' (ወታስተዐጽብ ፈድፋደ 'and she was astonished exceedingly', ch. 25) · 'she wonders at' with an object (ወታስተዐጽብ ክብረ ቤተ መንግሥት 'and she wonders at the glory of the royal house', ch. 29); cf. ዕጹብ 'wonderful, astonishing'
